Mark completed the first test in 8 hours at a rate of 5 questions per hour. The number of questions he completed is $ 8 \times 5 = 40 $ questions.

Mark completed the second test in 6 hours at the same rate. The number of questions he completed is $ 6 \times 5 = 30 $ questions.

The total number of questions he left incomplete is $ 75 - 40 + 100 - 30 $.

First, calculate the number of questions he completed in each test:
- First test: $ 8 \times 5 = 40 $
- Second test: $ 6 \times 5 = 30 $

The total number of questions he left incomplete is:
$$
75 - 40 + 100 - 30 = 125
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 125
